definition: Neuroprotective refers to having the potential to protect nerve tissue and brain-related functions from damage or degeneration. In this packet, it describes compounds or protein-related effects that may help counter processes such as amyloid buildup, oxidative stress, inflammation, and blood-brain barrier disruption linked to vascular dementia.
